title: 外资机构：科技板块回调，正在筑底
speaker: Christina Moon

segments.en: What are some of the metrics that you look to see that maybe this de-leveraging process is over, whether it's Korea or China?
segments.zh: 你关注哪些指标来判断去杠杆过程是否结束，无论是韩国还是中国？

segments.en: I think some have looked at things like earnings and fundamentals still look pretty okay. The leverage story seems to be that we've seen a bit more of a wash out now, but what are the clear signs for you that things are looking a bit more stable than before?
segments.zh: 有些人关注盈利和基本面，看起来还不错。杠杆的故事似乎是已经经历了一轮出清，但对你来说，哪些迹象表明市场比以前更稳定了？

segments.en: Sure. I would say valuations would be one key thing to look at. So seeing a lot of these valuations come off from prior peaks also does build a bit of buffer in there.
segments.zh: 当然。估值是关键指标之一。许多估值从之前的峰值回落，这提供了一些缓冲。

segments.en: Then of course you have to anchor all of this to fundamentals. I think the earnings season that we've seen so far has provided some comfort, especially within the tech trade. I think one of the key things that the market was looking out for were the hyperscaler capex announcements just a few weeks back.
segments.zh: 当然，这一切都要以基本面为锚。到目前为止的财报季提供了一些安慰，尤其是在科技领域。市场关注的关键点之一是几周前超大规模企业的资本开支公告。

segments.en: I think at least that has allowed the market to breathe a bit of a sigh of relief given that the numbers were a bit better than expected. Sure, you can, some part of that could be inflation-related, but I think the fact that many of these higher-component costs could have been absorbed also is a positive sign for the market.
segments.zh: 至少这让市场松了一口气，因为数据好于预期。当然，部分可能和通胀有关，但许多更高的成本被吸收了，这对市场来说是积极信号。

segments.en: So a number of these things, I think, got valuations. You've got end supply chain outlooks and you've got, I suppose, generally a positive outlooks across several of the companies that have reported so far. I think these are a number of things that do allow a bottoming in the correction of the tech trade.
segments.zh: 所以，这些因素包括估值、供应链前景，以及已公布财报的公司总体积极的前景。我认为这些因素使得科技板块的回调正在筑底。
